name: Natural Science Minor
intro: The minor in natural science will first provide students with a foundation in the basic sciences of physics, chemistry and biology. Each student will then build on these foundation courses by selecting a variety of electives to meet individual scientific interests and academic goals. Eighteen units toward the natural science minor must be completed at USC. This minor is not available to majors in the natural sciences
